subject: [PATCH] cgroup/cpuset: check effective mems for a movable-only configuration

2026-10-22.patch_summary: This patch modifies the cgroup/cpuset code to check for effective memory settings in a movable-only configuration. The change moves the check from the hotplug path to the update_nodemasks_hier function, where it can be performed more accurately. This prevents warnings when a task requests a movable node that is not present in its parent's nodemask, but will still warn if the parent's mems include the node later. The patch also removes an unnecessary check in the update_nodemask function.
